dateline: Arlington, Texas, USA — Dallas-Fort Worth ARMY fan events kick off ahead of the ARIRANG World Tour's two-night AT&T Stadium stop (Aug 15-16); 'SWIM' ties 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 weeks; 'ARIRANG' logs 20th consecutive week on Billboard 200; next stops: Toronto Rogers Stadium (Aug 22-23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,810: Dallas-Fort Worth ARMY Events Kick Off Ahead of Arlington Shows
heroSubtitle: August 14, 2026 is Day 4,810 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Ahead of the ARIRANG World Tour's two-night AT&T Stadium stop in Arlington (Aug 15-16), Dallas-Fort Worth ARMY events began today: Texas Live!'s 'Into the Boraverse' pre-concert party, official merch pickup at Esports Stadium Arlington, and cupsleeve events across the metroplex, per the Fort Worth Report and Fort Live. The stop follows the tour's two-night Baltimore run at M&T Bank Stadium (Aug 10-11), where the Baltimore Sun and Fox Baltimore reported ARMY traveled from as far as Mexico, Florida, and Ohio. On Aug 12, 'SWIM' tied 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 consecutive weeks (No. 91, chart dated Aug 15), holding No. 4 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) and No. 12 on the Billboard Global 200, while parent album 'ARIRANG' logged its own 20th consecutive week on the Billboard 200 (No. 14) — a record run for a K-pop album. The tour heads next to Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23), where City Council has approved temporarily renaming a stretch of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard.'
